universal_internal_imports.scope: Universal generating-one-class lemma: one hyperplane orbit, full pointwise-stabilizer order, and class rank=reflection rank. No sixteen-knot corollary is a premise.

augmentation_import.scope: A finite-dimensional irreducible complex KCH representation with nontrivial meridian eigenvalue induces an ordinary U=1 augmentation of the same rank. Ann(e1)=0 holds over the fieldC; longitude eigenvalue is arbitrary nonzero.

written_new_arguments.lem:active: For any group normally generated bym: averaging gives one faithful active irreducible summand. No knot-specific or augmentation fact is used.
written_new_arguments.lem:determinant: det(W) has order equal to the LCM of reflection orders. One generating class has a common determinant generating this image, hence must contain a reflection of that LCM order; the four mixed-order rows cannot occur.
written_new_arguments.lem:adjoint: After unitarization, det(g)Ad(g) is real orthogonal on traceless Hermitian2x2 matrices. Complex reducibility gives an invariant complex line; its conjugate supplies either a real line or a real invariant plane with orthogonal real line. That line gives an unordered pair of natural2D eigenspaces preserved byW, contradicting primitivity. Involutory reflections have twisted-adjoint eigenvalues(-1,1,1).
written_new_arguments.thm:domination: Cornwell Proposition2.12 and Definition1.8 convert the pure-group capacity representation into an ordinary augmentation of its dimension.
written_new_arguments.lem:capacity: For any normally generated(G,m) with one finite complex rank-one image, the exhaustive case constructions give an irreducible finite-image complex representation of dimension>=class-generating rank. No Cornwell or low-rank-only theorem is a premise.
written_new_arguments.cor:finitecapacity: The pure-group capacity construction gives finite-image KCH dimension>=each finite class bound; conversely a class generating set spans all normals in an irreducible rankone representation, bounding dimension by the class rank. Cyclic order2 images give nonemptiness and both integer sets lie in1..mr(K). Equality is independent of COR17.
